class.name: DSPreloader
class.brief_description: Static helper utility for collecting and prewarming scene texture assets.
class.description: [DSPreloader] provides a high-level static GDScript API over DirectStorage streaming and GPU decompression. It walks scene dependencies to discover texture paths, issues stream prewarm requests through [DSTextureCache], and coordinates with the [code]DSRuntime[/code] autoload for non-blocking scene loading.

method.name: await_prewarm_finished
method.description: Awaits completion of prewarm batch [param tag] across frame updates without blocking the main thread, optionally invoking [param on_progress] with [code](done, total)[/code] each frame.

method.name: cancel_prewarm
method.description: Marks prewarm batch [param tag] as cancelled so pending requests terminate and [method is_prewarm_complete] evaluates to [code]true[/code].

method.name: collect_scene_textures
method.description: Recursively collects all prewarmable texture dependencies for [param scene_path], also sweeping [param extra_scan_dirs] for dynamically loaded assets.

method.name: get_prewarm_progress
method.description: Returns [code]Vector2i(completed, total)[/code] items processed for prewarm batch [param tag].

method.name: is_gpu_prewarm_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if Direct3D 12 hardware GPU decompression prewarm directly into VRAM is supported and active.

method.name: is_prewarm_complete
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all requests for prewarm batch [param tag] have finished and all textures are cached.

method.name: is_stream_prewarm_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the native DirectStorage streaming pipeline singletons are active and available.

method.name: load_scene_with_loading_screen
method.description: Orchestrates asynchronous prewarm, scene loading, instantiation, tree attachment, and frame settling under an active loading screen overlay.

method.name: prewarm_async
method.description: Enqueues texture [param paths] for asynchronous CPU memory streaming prewarm and returns the assigned batch tag.

method.name: prewarm_gpu_async
method.description: Enqueues texture [param paths] for direct-to-GPU VRAM DMA streaming prewarm in chunks of [param chunk_size] and returns the batch tag.

List of resource container extensions inspected during recursive dependency traversal.
Default per-frame processing budget in microseconds used during main-thread fallback loading.
